title: Ordinary differential equations
audience: a college student in a mathematics degree program (or a related major such as physics, computer science or economics), or an adult studying the same material on their own
purpose: Solve and interpret evolution equations, checking initial conditions, stability and numerical approximations.

blocks.deliverable: Solve initial value problems and state their valid intervals.
Classify damping regimes and compute transients.
Compare particular solutions and explain resonance.
Week 7 midterm; solve one switched input problem.
Compare Euler and a higher order integrator as step size changes.
Submit the report and an unseen 120 minute final.

project: Analyze a driven damped oscillator and compare analytic, phase plane and numerical results.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
